title.zh: 原子与虚空的自然哲学
title.en: Atomism and void in natural philosophy

rationale.zh: 以微观构成解释物质变化的历史思想，不等同现代原子理论。
rationale.en: A historical microscopic account of matter, distinct from modern atomic theory.

sources.title: Cambridge Companion to Early Greek Philosophy — The atomists

dateNote.zh: 来源明确将原子论的创立置于公元前5世纪；按整世纪编码，不是精确提出年。该思辨理论不计入已成立物理突破指数。
dateNote.en: The authority places the origin in the fifth century BCE, encoded as a century, not an exact year. This speculative proposal is excluded from the established-advances index.

title.zh: 欧几里得的几何光学
title.en: Euclidean geometrical optics

rationale.zh: 以几何推理系统研究视觉角和表观大小。
rationale.en: Systematized visual angles and apparent size through geometry.

dateNote.zh: 专门光学史给出约公元前300年；保留约年，不人为设定误差宽度。
dateNote.en: The optical history dates Optica to about 300 BCE; no arbitrary uncertainty interval is invented.

title.zh: 浮力与浮体平衡理论
title.en: Buoyancy and the equilibrium of floating bodies

rationale.zh: 为浮力和浮体稳定性提供数学处理。
rationale.en: Provided a mathematical treatment of buoyancy and floating stability.

sources.title: Georgia Tech — Mysteries of Floating, John McCuan

dateNote.zh: 数学研究史列为约公元前250年，不是精确发表年。
dateNote.en: A mathematical research chronology places the work around 250 BCE, not an exact publication year.

title.zh: 喜帕恰斯的恒星星表
title.en: Hipparchus’s stellar catalogue

rationale.zh: 建立定量恒星位置资料，推动观测天文学。
rationale.en: Advanced quantitative positional astronomy through a stellar catalogue.

dateNote.zh: 来源称星表可能于公元前129年完成，属于约年。
dateNote.en: The source says the catalogue was probably completed in 129 BCE.

title.zh: 候风地动仪
title.en: Zhang Heng’s earthquake-direction instrument

rationale.zh: 将机械响应用于远方地震方向指示。
rationale.en: Applied a mechanical response to indicating distant earthquake direction.

dateNote.zh: 记载的制作年；其内部结构的现代复原存在争论。
dateNote.en: Recorded construction year; modern reconstructions of its mechanism remain debated.

title.zh: 《天文学大成》的定量天体模型
title.en: Quantitative celestial models in the Almagest

rationale.zh: 组织观测和数学模型，形成长期使用的预测体系。
rationale.en: Organized observations and mathematical models into a durable predictive system.

sources.title: Oxford Classical Dictionary — Ptolemy, mathematical writer

dateNote.zh: Oxford Classical Dictionary给出约150年出版。该历史地心模型不作为已成立物理原理计入指数。
dateNote.en: Oxford Classical Dictionary gives publication around 150. The historical geocentric model is excluded from the established-advances index.

title.zh: 《阿耶波多历数书》的天体运动计算
title.en: Celestial calculations in the Aryabhatiya

rationale.zh: 结合地球自转思想和日月食的几何计算。
rationale.en: Combined a rotating-Earth account with geometrical eclipse calculations.

dateNote.zh: 取作者在书中给出的完成年份。
dateNote.en: Uses the completion year stated by the author.

title.zh: 对亚里士多德运动学的批判
title.en: Philoponus’s critique of Aristotelian motion

rationale.zh: 质疑抛射运动和下落速度的传统解释。
rationale.en: Challenged traditional accounts of projectile motion and falling speed.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — John Philoponus

dateNote.zh: 《物理学注》的初稿年代为517年，现存文本含后期修订。
dateNote.en: The Physics commentary is dated to 517 but contains later revisions.

title.zh: 《婆罗摩修正体系》的数学天文学
title.en: Mathematical astronomy in the Brahmasphutasiddhanta

rationale.zh: 改进天体位置、日月食和观测工具的计算。
rationale.en: Developed calculations of celestial positions, eclipses and instruments.

dateNote.zh: 取著作写作年。
dateNote.en: Uses the work’s composition year.

title.zh: 伊本·萨赫勒的折射与透镜几何
title.en: Ibn Sahl’s refraction and lens geometry

rationale.zh: 用等价于正弦折射关系的几何方法设计聚焦透镜。
rationale.en: Used geometry equivalent to a sine refraction relation in lens design.

dateNote.zh: 光学论著通常记于约984年，不代表精确实验日期。
dateNote.en: The optical treatise is conventionally dated around 984.

title.zh: 《光学书》的视觉与光传播研究
title.en: Vision and light propagation in the Book of Optics

rationale.zh: 结合实验与几何分析，系统发展外界光入眼的视觉解释。
rationale.en: Combined experiments and geometry in a systematic account of vision.

sources.title: Cambridge University Press — A Practical Guide to Portable Pupillometry, early history

dateNote.zh: 所引Cambridge著作给出1011—1021年写作区间；依赖传记传统，书的精确编写次序仍待专门史学版本复核，因此标暂定。
dateNote.en: The cited Cambridge work gives 1011–1021. The precise composition sequence needs specialist textual review; dating is provisional.

title.zh: 《梦溪笔谈》中的磁偏角与成像记录
title.en: Magnetic declination and imaging in Dream Pool Essays

rationale.zh: 记录磁北与真北的偏离，并讨论小孔成像。
rationale.en: Recorded magnetic declination and discussed pinhole imaging.

sources.title: University of Washington Press — Good Formulas, chapter 1

dateNote.zh: 大学出版研究将《梦溪笔谈》完成置于1088—1095年；按此区间编码，而非指定1088单年。
dateNote.en: The university-press study places completion between 1088 and 1095; the interval is retained.

title.zh: 《大著作》中的光学与实验论述
title.en: Optics and experience in the Opus maius

rationale.zh: 将几何光学和经验研究纳入系统学术论述。
rationale.en: Integrated geometrical optics and experiential inquiry into a systematic work.

dateNote.zh: 取提交《大著作》的年代。
dateNote.en: Uses the year in which the Opus maius was submitted.

title.zh: 《新科学》的定量弹道研究
title.en: Quantitative ballistics in Nova scientia

rationale.zh: 把炮弹轨迹和射角问题纳入系统数学研究。
rationale.en: Brought projectile paths and firing angles into systematic mathematical study.

dateNote.zh: 取《新科学》出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Nova scientia.

title.zh: 《天体运行论》的日心体系
title.en: The heliocentric system of De revolutionibus

rationale.zh: 重组行星运动的数学框架，推动后来的天体力学。
rationale.en: Reorganized planetary models and helped establish later celestial mechanics.

sources.title: University of Glasgow — Copernicus: De Revolutionibus (1543)

dateNote.zh: 取正式出版年，不把更早手稿传播另计一次。
dateNote.en: Uses formal publication; earlier manuscript circulation is not counted again.

title.zh: 区分介质阻力与真空落体
title.en: Distinguishing medium resistance and free fall in a vacuum

rationale.zh: 质疑重量与下落速度的简单比例关系。
rationale.en: Questioned a simple proportionality between weight and falling speed.

sources.title: Edition Open Sources — Science in Court Society: Benedetti’s works

dateNote.zh: 1553年的初步说法仍有介质处理错误；采用1554年修订中把等速下落限定于真空的论述，不重复计初版。
dateNote.en: The 1553 account mishandled resistance; uses the 1554 revision restricting equal fall to a vacuum.

title.zh: 新星位置与天界变化的观测证据
title.en: Positional evidence for a new star and changing heavens

rationale.zh: 通过视差检验挑战天界不变的传统观念。
rationale.en: Used parallax tests to challenge an unchanging celestial realm.

sources.title: Rice University — Galileo Project: Tycho Brahe
Cambridge University Press — Tycho Brahe, new-star report excerpt

dateNote.zh: 新星出现于1572，按1573年公开著作定年。
dateNote.en: The star appeared in 1572; dates the public book of 1573.

title.zh: 斯特芬的流体静压理论
title.en: Stevin’s theory of hydrostatic pressure

rationale.zh: 明确液体压力与深度及受压面的关系。
rationale.en: Clarified relations among liquid pressure, depth and loaded area.

dateNote.zh: 与静力学著作是不同的流体成果，合作者不重复计数。
dateNote.en: A distinct fluid result, rather than a duplicate author-based count.

title.zh: 斯特芬的静力学与力的合成
title.en: Stevin’s statics and composition of forces

rationale.zh: 系统研究斜面、平衡与力的几何关系。
rationale.en: Systematically treated inclined planes, equilibrium and force geometry.

dateNote.zh: 取《论衡》的出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of The Principles of the Art of Weighing.

title.zh: 彗星位于月球之外的视差证据
title.en: Parallax evidence that comets lie beyond the Moon

rationale.zh: 以观测削弱固体天球和天界不变的物理假设。
rationale.en: Used observations against solid celestial spheres and unchanging heavens.

sources.title: University of Oklahoma — Brahe, Complete Works and De mundi aetherei

dateNote.zh: 观测对象为1577年彗星，按1588年报告出版定位。
dateNote.en: The observations concern the 1577 comet; the report was published in 1588.

title.zh: 《论磁》的地磁与电性实验
title.en: Terrestrial magnetism and electrical experiments in De magnete

rationale.zh: 以系统实验将地球看作磁体，并区分电性与磁性。
rationale.en: Systematically investigated Earth as a magnet and distinguished electrical effects.

sources.title: University of Oklahoma — On the Magnet

dateNote.zh: 取1600年出版；只计获实验支持的磁学与电学推进，不采纳书中全部宇宙论。
dateNote.en: Uses publication in 1600; only supported magnetic and electrical advances are scored.

title.zh: 开普勒的视网膜成像理论
title.en: Kepler’s account of retinal images

rationale.zh: 把视觉成像作为光学系统的几何问题处理。
rationale.en: Treated visual imaging as a geometrical optical-system problem.

dateNote.zh: 取Astronomiae pars optica出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Astronomiae pars optica.

title.zh: 行星椭圆轨道与面积定律
title.en: Elliptical planetary orbits and the area law

rationale.zh: 用定量定律替换行星圆周运动的传统约束。
rationale.en: Replaced circular-orbit constraints with quantitative planetary laws.

sources.title: Bavarian Academy of Sciences — Kepler’s planetary laws

dateNote.zh: 取《新天文学》出版年，前两定律作为同一组建模突破计一次。
dateNote.en: Astronomia nova publication; the first two laws form one modelling milestone.

title.zh: 《星际信使》中的望远镜天文发现
title.en: Telescopic discoveries in Sidereus nuncius

rationale.zh: 以新仪器展示月面地形、木星卫星和更多恒星。
rationale.en: Used telescopes to reveal lunar relief, Jovian moons and additional stars.

dateNote.zh: 把同一观察报告作为一项成果，不按每张图重复。
dateNote.en: Treats the observational report as one event rather than counting each illustration.

title.zh: 《折光学》的透镜与望远镜理论
title.en: Lens and telescope theory in Dioptrice

rationale.zh: 为折射透镜组合和望远镜提供系统几何分析。
rationale.en: Provided systematic geometrical analysis of lenses and telescopes.

dateNote.zh: 取《折光学》出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Dioptrice.

title.zh: 大范围三角测量与地球尺度估计
title.en: Large-scale triangulation and Earth measurement

rationale.zh: 将角度测量网络用于地球尺寸的定量估计。
rationale.en: Used an angular survey network for quantitative Earth measurement.

dateNote.zh: 取Eratosthenes Batavus出版年；不把未刊折射研究虚作同年公开。
dateNote.en: Uses publication of Eratosthenes Batavus, not unpublished refraction research.

title.zh: 行星运动的周期—轨道尺度关系
title.en: The period–orbital-size relation

rationale.zh: 把不同行星的运动联系到共同数量关系。
rationale.en: Connected different planetary motions through one quantitative relation.

dateNote.zh: 取《宇宙和谐论》出版年，不另计1618年的研究过程。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Harmonices mundi; the 1618 development is not counted separately.

title.zh: 卡斯泰利的流量连续性研究
title.en: Castelli’s study of flow continuity

rationale.zh: 推进水流截面、速度与流量的定量联系。
rationale.en: Advanced quantitative relations between flow area, speed and discharge.

sources.title: Museo Galileo Library — Castelli, Della misura delle acque correnti (1628)

dateNote.zh: 按1628年首版馆藏记录；部分传记记1629年，原版题录优先。
dateNote.en: Uses the library record of the 1628 first edition; some biographies give 1629.

title.zh: 《普遍和谐论》的弦振动研究
title.en: String vibration in Harmonie universelle

rationale.zh: 把声音与弦长、张力和振动频率联系到定量实验。
rationale.en: Related sound and string properties through quantitative experiments.

dateNote.zh: 取《普遍和谐论》出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Harmonie universelle.

title.zh: 《折光学》的折射定律与成像分析
title.en: Refraction and imaging in La Dioptrique

rationale.zh: 公开系统表述折射关系与透镜成像分析。
rationale.en: Published a systematic treatment of refraction and lens imaging.

dateNote.zh: 更早的未刊独立发现保留在人物档案，不据此额外增加同一公开成果。
dateNote.en: Earlier unpublished independent work is retained in profiles, not counted as this publication again.

title.zh: 《两门新科学》的落体与抛体力学
title.en: Falling bodies and projectiles in Two New Sciences

rationale.zh: 将定量实验与数学运动规律结合，奠定近代运动学。
rationale.en: Joined quantitative experiments with mathematical laws of motion.

sources.title: University of Oklahoma — The New Physics (1638)

dateNote.zh: 同书的落体与抛体成果作为一组关联运动学突破计一次。
dateNote.en: Related falling-body and projectile results are counted as one kinematic milestone.

title.zh: 流出速度与液面高度的定量关系
title.en: The relation between efflux speed and liquid head

rationale.zh: 为流体流出问题提供数学关系。
rationale.en: Provided a mathematical relation for fluid discharge.

dateNote.zh: 取Opera geometrica出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Opera geometrica.

title.zh: 水银柱与大气压的实验证据
title.en: Mercury-column evidence for atmospheric pressure

rationale.zh: 以可维持的真空和水银柱阐明大气压力。
rationale.en: Used a sustained vacuum and mercury column to explain atmospheric pressure.

dateNote.zh: 实验始于1643；1644年致Ricci信是可定年的科学报告。
dateNote.en: Experiments began in 1643; the 1644 Ricci letter is a dated scientific report.

title.zh: 气压随海拔变化的实验
title.en: Experiment on atmospheric pressure and altitude

rationale.zh: 用不同高度的水银柱读数检验大气压解释。
rationale.en: Tested atmospheric-pressure explanations through measurements at different heights.

dateNote.zh: 由Périer等执行的山地实验归为同一成果。
dateNote.en: The mountain experiment carried out by Périer and others is one shared result.

title.zh: 空气泵实验与空气弹性
title.en: Air-pump experiments and the spring of air

rationale.zh: 使真空与低压环境成为可重复研究的实验条件。
rationale.en: Made low-pressure environments accessible to repeatable experiments.

dateNote.zh: 取New Experiments第一版出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of the first edition of New Experiments.

title.zh: 气体压强—体积关系
title.en: The pressure–volume relation of gases

rationale.zh: 建立可复现实验支持的定量气体关系。
rationale.en: Established a reproducible quantitative gas relation.

dateNote.zh: 关系见1662年第二版附录；Mariotte后来独立研究另保留归属说明。
dateNote.en: The relation appears in the 1662 appendix; later independent work by Mariotte is acknowledged.

title.zh: 最短时间原理推导折射
title.en: Refraction derived from the principle of least time

rationale.zh: 以变分式原则连接光路与传播速度。
rationale.en: Connected optical paths and propagation speed through an extremal principle.

dateNote.zh: 取1662年光学论述，而非更早的一般最简道路表述。
dateNote.en: Uses the 1662 optical derivation rather than earlier general shortest-path statements.

title.zh: 光的衍射研究公开发表
title.en: Publication of Grimaldi’s diffraction studies

rationale.zh: 揭示几何光学阴影之外的光传播结构。
rationale.en: Revealed light structures beyond geometrical shadow boundaries.

dateNote.zh: 实验较早完成；取身后著作出版年。
dateNote.en: Experiments preceded the posthumous publication year used here.

title.zh: 白光的复合性与光色理论
title.en: The composite nature of white light

rationale.zh: 把颜色与不同折射性质的光联系起来。
rationale.en: Connected colours with rays having distinct refractive properties.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Newton prism experiment, 1672

dateNote.zh: 实验始于1660年代；取皇家学会公开报告年，旧历可能写1671/72。
dateNote.en: Uses public reporting, not the 1660s experiments; Old Style dates may read 1671/72.

title.zh: 复摆与圆周运动的数学理论
title.en: Mathematical theory of pendulums and circular motion

rationale.zh: 扩展对刚体摆动、等时曲线和离心作用的研究。
rationale.en: Extended treatments of pendulums, tautochrones and circular motion.

dateNote.zh: 取Horologium oscillatorium出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Horologium oscillatorium.

title.zh: 以木卫食时差推断有限光速
title.en: Finite light speed inferred from Jovian eclipse delays

rationale.zh: 为光传播需要时间提供天文观测证据。
rationale.en: Provided astronomical evidence that light propagation takes time.

sources.title: Physics Today — Rømer and the finite speed of light

dateNote.zh: 取1676年法文报告，1677年英文转述不再次计数。
dateNote.en: Uses the 1676 French report; the 1677 English account is not recounted.

title.zh: 弹性形变的线性定律
title.en: The linear law of elastic deformation

rationale.zh: 建立弹性力与形变的定量联系。
rationale.en: Established a quantitative relation between elastic force and deformation.

dateNote.zh: 发现于1660年前后；一般定律于1678年Of Spring公开。
dateNote.en: Discovered around 1660; the general law was publicly stated in Of Spring in 1678.

title.zh: 《光论》的波动光学
title.en: Wave optics in the Treatise on Light

rationale.zh: 以传播波前解释反射、折射及双折射。
rationale.en: Explained reflection, refraction and double refraction through propagating wavefronts.

sources.title: Kanazawa Institute of Technology — Traité de la lumière (1690), first announced in 1678

dateNote.zh: 取1678年法国科学院首次报告年；1690年正式出版不重复计数。部分简短传记混淆报告与出版，已以大学原版馆藏说明核对。
dateNote.en: Uses the 1678 French Academy presentation; the 1690 printed edition is not counted again.

title.zh: 微分法的公开发表
title.en: Publication of differential calculus

rationale.zh: 为运动、变化和极值问题提供可推广的分析工具。
rationale.en: Provided general analytical tools for motion, change and extrema.

dateNote.zh: 取Nova methodus出版年，独立发明及优先权问题另作历史说明。
dateNote.en: Uses publication of Nova methodus, while preserving independent-development qualifications.

title.zh: 运动定律与万有引力的统一体系
title.en: A unified system of motion and universal gravitation

rationale.zh: 以统一数学框架连接地面运动与天体运动。
rationale.en: Unified terrestrial and celestial motion in a mathematical framework.

sources.title: University of Glasgow — Newton: Principia, first edition 1687

dateNote.zh: 《原理》三卷作为同一框架成果，不逐条定律重复计分。
dateNote.en: The three books of Principia form one framework event, not one score per law.

title.zh: 蒸汽冷凝驱动活塞的构想
title.en: A piston driven by steam condensation

rationale.zh: 把蒸汽、真空和活塞联系成热动力装置方案。
rationale.en: Connected steam, vacuum and a piston in a heat-engine proposal.

sources.title: Science Museum Group — apparatus proposed by Denis Papin, 1690

dateNote.zh: 装置方案的公开年代；不是声称已实现工业发动机。
dateNote.en: Dates the public apparatus proposal, not a completed industrial engine.

title.zh: 预测周期彗星的回归
title.en: Prediction of a periodic comet’s return

rationale.zh: 把牛顿动力学用于跨历次观测的轨道预测。
rationale.en: Applied Newtonian dynamics to orbital prediction across apparitions.

dateNote.zh: 取预测的发表年，而不是1758年回归年。
dateNote.en: Uses publication of the prediction, not the 1758 return.

title.zh: 气体放电与摩擦电实验体系
title.en: Gas-discharge and frictional-electricity experiments

rationale.zh: 改进电与低压气体发光的实验方法。
rationale.en: Developed experimental methods for electricity and low-pressure luminescence.

dateNote.zh: 取实验专著公开年，书中较早实验不再次按章节重复计数。
dateNote.en: Uses the experimental monograph’s publication, without recounting its earlier experiments.

title.zh: 实用大气式蒸汽机
title.en: A practical atmospheric steam engine

rationale.zh: 把蒸汽冷凝与大气压转化为实用机械功。
rationale.en: Turned steam condensation and atmospheric pressure into practical mechanical work.

dateNote.zh: 取首台实用装置的公开运行年。
dateNote.en: Uses the first practical engine’s public operation year.

title.zh: 可复现的华氏温标
title.en: The reproducible Fahrenheit temperature scale

rationale.zh: 推进温度测量的标准化与跨实验比较。
rationale.en: Advanced reproducible thermometry and comparison across experiments.

dateNote.zh: 取温标公开年，不把更早水银温度计另算同一温标成果。
dateNote.en: Dates the announced scale rather than earlier mercury thermometers.

title.zh: 恒星光行差的公开报告
title.en: Public report of stellar aberration

rationale.zh: 把有限光速与地球公转联系到观测位移。
rationale.en: Connected finite light speed and Earth’s orbit with observed stellar displacement.

dateNote.zh: 常见发现年1728；此处按1729年1月皇家学会宣读的报告定年。
dateNote.en: Often dated as a 1728 discovery; uses the January 1729 Royal Society report.

title.zh: 导电与绝缘实验的公开报告
title.en: Public report of conduction and insulation experiments

rationale.zh: 区分电性传递与材料绝缘作用。
rationale.en: Distinguished the transmission of electrical effects and insulating behaviour.

sources.title: Royal Society Archives — Gray’s electrical experiments (1731)

dateNote.zh: 实验始于1729，按1731年5月皇家学会宣读报告定年。
dateNote.en: Experiments began in 1729; uses the Royal Society report read in May 1731.

title.zh: 两种电性与吸引排斥关系
title.en: Two kinds of electricity and their interactions

rationale.zh: 区分两类带电行为，为电荷理论提供实验基础。
rationale.en: Distinguished two electrical behaviours that informed later charge theories.

sources.title: Du Fay — Concerning electricity, Philosophical Transactions, 1733

dateNote.zh: 按原始论文的卷年1733记录；部分印本标1733–34。
dateNote.en: Uses the original paper’s volume year 1733; some imprints span 1733–34.

title.zh: 解析方法系统处理质点动力学
title.en: Analytical treatment of particle dynamics

rationale.zh: 把运动问题系统写成可分析的微分方程。
rationale.en: Systematically cast dynamical problems into differential equations.

dateNote.zh: 取Mechanica出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Mechanica.

title.zh: 《流体动力学》的压力与流速研究
title.en: Pressure and flow speed in Hydrodynamica

rationale.zh: 将能量思路用于流体运动的定量分析。
rationale.en: Applied energetic reasoning to quantitative fluid motion.

dateNote.zh: 1734年已有稿本，采用1738年出版年。
dateNote.en: A draft existed in 1734; uses publication in 1738.

title.zh: 气体压强的粒子运动解释
title.en: A kinetic explanation of gas pressure

rationale.zh: 以粒子运动解释气体宏观性质的早期定量模型。
rationale.en: An early quantitative model relating particle motion to macroscopic gas properties.

dateNote.zh: 与同书流体结果为不同物理主张，未把后来的完整气体动理论归于此时。
dateNote.en: A distinct claim in the same book, not the later fully developed kinetic theory.

title.zh: 《物理学基础》的力学与能量讨论
title.en: Mechanics and vis viva in Institutions de physique

rationale.zh: 把牛顿与莱布尼茨传统的关键问题纳入系统讨论。
rationale.en: Systematically examined issues across Newtonian and Leibnizian traditions.

dateNote.zh: 取Institutions de physique出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Institutions de physique.

title.zh: 以水的相变固定点定义百分温标
title.en: A hundred-degree scale defined by water phase points

rationale.zh: 使温标与可重复的相变固定点关联。
rationale.en: Related a temperature scale to reproducible phase-transition fixed points.

dateNote.zh: 原始刻度沸点为0、冰点为100，与后来的常用方向相反。
dateNote.en: The original scale assigned 0 to boiling and 100 to freezing.

title.zh: 弹道摆与高速抛射体测量
title.en: The ballistic pendulum and projectile measurement

rationale.zh: 用动量转移把高速运动转化为可测的摆动。
rationale.en: Converted high-speed motion into measurable pendulum displacement.

dateNote.zh: 取New Principles of Gunnery出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of New Principles of Gunnery.

title.zh: 地球形状、转动与引力的定量理论
title.en: A quantitative theory of Earth’s figure and gravity

rationale.zh: 将大地测量与旋转流体的引力理论连接。
rationale.en: Connected geodetic measurements with rotating-fluid gravitation.

dateNote.zh: 取Théorie de la figure de la Terre出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Théorie de la figure de la Terre.

title.zh: 达朗贝尔原理
title.en: D’Alembert’s principle

rationale.zh: 把约束系统动力学联系到平衡与虚功分析。
rationale.en: Related constrained dynamics to equilibrium and virtual-work reasoning.

dateNote.zh: 取Traité de dynamique出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Traité de dynamique.

title.zh: 振动弦的波动方程
title.en: The wave equation for a vibrating string

rationale.zh: 把波动运动表述为偏微分方程。
rationale.en: Expressed wave motion through a partial differential equation.

sources.title: MacTutor — Archibald on mathematicians and music: the 1747 vibrating-string memoir
Treccani, Storia della Scienza — d’Alembert’s 1747 presentation of the vibrating-string memoirs

dateNote.zh: 采用1747年向柏林科学院提交论文的年代；对应卷实际稍后印刷，不能把卷年误当印刷年。
dateNote.en: Uses the 1747 academy presentation; the corresponding volume was printed later.

title.zh: 正负电性与电荷转移的系统实验
title.en: Systematic experiments on electrical charge and transfer

rationale.zh: 把多种静电现象组织成可检验的电性解释。
rationale.en: Organized electrostatic phenomena into a testable electrical account.

sources.title: Royal Society Archives — Franklin to Collinson, electrical experiments (1751)
Library of Congress — Franklin: Experiments in electricity

dateNote.zh: 取首版论著公开年；较早通信与后续版本不重复累加。
dateNote.en: Uses the first published edition; earlier letters and later editions are not counted repeatedly.

title.zh: 理想流体运动的一般方程
title.en: General equations of ideal-fluid motion

rationale.zh: 建立连续介质流动的统一微分方程表述。
rationale.en: Established a general differential-equation formulation of continuum flow.

sources.title: Euler Archive — General principles of fluid motion (1757)
Bibliothèque nationale de France — Euler et les jets d’eau de Sans-Souci

dateNote.zh: 论文写于1755，卷题亦含1755，实际出版于1757。
dateNote.en: Written in 1755 in a volume labelled 1755, but published in 1757.

title.zh: 以距离相关力描述点状物质
title.en: Point-matter and distance-dependent forces

rationale.zh: 探索统一的物质相互作用模型，具有历史影响但非现代原子理论。
rationale.en: Explored a historically influential unified interaction model, not modern atomic theory.

dateNote.zh: 取Theoria philosophiae naturalis出版年。 历史思想记录，不作为已成立物理原理计入突破指数。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Theoria philosophiae naturalis. Historical proposal; excluded from the index of established physical advances.

title.zh: 电与磁现象的数学理论
title.en: A mathematical theory of electrical and magnetic phenomena

rationale.zh: 把电荷作用与感应问题纳入数学化模型。
rationale.en: Brought electrical interactions and induction into a mathematical model.

dateNote.zh: 取Tentamen出版年。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Tentamen.

title.zh: 定量光度学与漫反射定律
title.en: Quantitative photometry and diffuse reflection

rationale.zh: 建立可测量的光强与几何关系。
rationale.en: Established measurable relations between illumination and geometry.

dateNote.zh: 取Photometria出版年；不将此前Bouguer的吸收研究重复归功。
dateNote.en: Publication year of Photometria; earlier absorption work by Bouguer is not reassigned.

title.zh: 潜热与比热的公开报告
title.en: Public report of latent and specific heat

rationale.zh: 区分热量输入与温度变化，推进定量热学。
rationale.en: Distinguished heat input from temperature change in quantitative thermal study.

dateNote.zh: 实验常记1761；按1762年格拉斯哥学会报告定年，生前未正式出版。
dateNote.en: Experiments are often dated 1761; uses the 1762 Glasgow society report, not a lifetime publication.

title.zh: 刚体转动的系统理论
title.en: A systematic theory of rigid-body rotation

rationale.zh: 将动力学从质点扩展到一般刚体运动。
rationale.en: Extended dynamics from particles to general rigid-body motion.

sources.title: Euler Archive — Theory of the motion of rigid bodies (1765)
ETH Library — Theoria motus corporum solidorum (1765)

dateNote.zh: 著作写于1760，按1765年出版定年。
dateNote.en: Written in 1760; dated by publication in 1765.

title.zh: 独立冷凝器的公开专利
title.en: The separate-condenser patent

rationale.zh: 减少汽缸反复冷却的损失，改进热机效率。
rationale.en: Reduced repeated cylinder-cooling losses and improved heat-engine efficiency.

sources.title: Science Museum — James Watt and the separate condenser
Powerhouse Collection — Watt’s separate condenser patent (1769)

dateNote.zh: 1765年模型与1769年专利合并为一项，按公开专利年定位。
dateNote.en: The 1765 models and 1769 patent form one event, anchored to the public patent.

title.zh: 阿特伍德机的首次公开描述
title.en: The first published description of Atwood’s machine

rationale.zh: 降低有效加速度以测量和展示运动规律。
rationale.en: Reduced effective acceleration to measure and demonstrate motion.

dateNote.zh: 首个法文描述为1780年；常见1784年为作者英文专著。
dateNote.en: The first French description dates to 1780; the familiar 1784 date is his English treatise.

title.zh: 冰量热计与定量热量测量
title.en: Ice calorimetry and quantitative heat measurement

rationale.zh: 用融冰量测量物体、化学变化与呼吸放热。
rationale.en: Used ice melting to quantify heat from bodies, reactions and respiration.

sources.title: Smithsonian — Lavoisier–Laplace calorimeter and Memoir sur la Chaleur (1783)
Science Museum Group — Replica of Lavoisier’s calorimeter
University of Vienna — Ice calorimeter: first presentation in 1780

dateNote.zh: 维也纳大学馆藏史将仪器原理首次向巴黎科学院提出记为1780；1783年热学论文的后续发表不另计。
dateNote.en: Vienna’s collection history dates the first academy presentation to 1780; the later 1783 heat memoir is not counted again.

title.zh: 发现天王星
title.en: Discovery of Uranus

rationale.zh: 把太阳系行星的观测范围扩展到古代已知行星之外。
rationale.en: Extended the observed planetary system beyond the planets known in antiquity.

dateNote.zh: 最初报告为彗星状天体，行星身份随后确立。
dateNote.en: Initially reported as a comet-like object; planetary identification followed.

title.zh: 《论一般机器》的机械效应分析
title.en: Mechanical-effect analysis in Essay on Machines

rationale.zh: 以统一机械分析讨论碰撞与机器中的效应损失。
rationale.en: Analyzed losses of mechanical effect in impacts and machines.

dateNote.zh: 1778年初稿、1781年修订，采用1783年公开出版年。
dateNote.en: Drafted in 1778 and revised in 1781; uses publication in 1783.

title.zh: 静电力的平方反比定律
title.en: The inverse-square law of electrostatic force

rationale.zh: 把静电相互作用建立为定量实验定律。
rationale.en: Established electrostatic interaction as a quantitative experimental law.

dateNote.zh: 取首组扭秤论文的提交与出版年代。
dateNote.en: Dates the first torsion-balance memoirs.

title.zh: 卡罗琳·赫歇尔独立发现彗星
title.en: Caroline Herschel’s independent comet discovery

rationale.zh: 贡献独立天体观测，扩充可靠的太阳系资料。
rationale.en: Added independent observations to reliable Solar System records.

dateNote.zh: 取1786年8月1日观测；不以个人荣誉代替物理成果。
dateNote.en: Uses the observation of 1 August 1786, rather than a personal award.

title.zh: 以砂粒显示振动板的节线
title.en: Visualizing nodal lines of vibrating plates

rationale.zh: 使固体振动模态成为可重复观察的实验图样。
rationale.en: Made solid-body vibration modes visible in repeatable experiments.

sources.title: University of Geneva — Voir le son

dateNote.zh: 取实验著作出版年，而非后来演示器件的制造年代。
dateNote.en: Uses publication of the experiments, not the manufacture of later apparatus.

title.zh: 《分析力学》的广义坐标体系
title.en: Generalized-coordinate mechanics in Mécanique analytique

rationale.zh: 以统一分析方法处理受约束的机械系统。
rationale.en: Unified the analytical treatment of constrained mechanical systems.

dateNote.zh: 取1788年首版，后续版本不重复计分。
dateNote.en: Uses the 1788 first edition; later editions are not recounted.

title.zh: 电刺激与肌肉收缩的系统研究
title.en: Electrical stimulation and muscular contraction

rationale.zh: 为电与生理过程的关系提供系统实验。
rationale.en: Provided systematic experiments linking electricity and physiological processes.

sources.title: University of Bologna Museum — Galvani’s 1791 experiment

dateNote.zh: 按Bologna大学所记1789年学院报告定位；1791年出版的同一成果不重复计数。
dateNote.en: Uses the academy presentation in 1789 recorded by Bologna; the same result’s 1791 publication is not recounted.

title.zh: 订正并扩充弗拉姆斯蒂德星表
title.en: Correction and extension of Flamsteed’s catalogue

rationale.zh: 纠正观测索引并补入遗漏恒星，改善观测基础资料。
rationale.en: Corrected observational indexing and added omitted stars.

dateNote.zh: 取向皇家学会提交并出版星表索引的年代。
dateNote.en: Dates submission and publication of the catalogue index.

title.zh: 扭秤测定地球平均密度
title.en: Torsion-balance determination of Earth’s mean density

rationale.zh: 把微弱引力的实验测量用于确定地球密度。
rationale.en: Used measurements of weak gravitational attraction to determine Earth’s density.

sources.title: Royal Society Archives — Experiments to determine the density of the earth (1798)
Cavendish — Experiments to determine the density of the earth

dateNote.zh: 原论文目标是地球密度，不把它直接表述为作者测量G。
dateNote.en: The original target was Earth’s density, not a claimed direct measurement of G.

title.zh: 摩擦持续生热的实验
title.en: Experiments on sustained heat production by friction

rationale.zh: 用机械摩擦不断生热质疑热质作为有限物质的解释。
rationale.en: Used sustained frictional heating to challenge material caloric accounts.

sources.title: Rumford — Inquiry concerning heat excited by friction (1798)

dateNote.zh: 取1798年皇家学会宣读和出版年。
dateNote.en: Uses the 1798 Royal Society reading and publication year.

title.zh: 发现红外辐射
title.en: Discovery of infrared radiation

rationale.zh: 把辐射研究扩展到可见光谱之外。
rationale.en: Extended the study of radiation beyond the visible spectrum.

dateNote.zh: 取实验报告年，与1781年发现天王星分别计为独立成果。
dateNote.en: Dates the experimental report; distinct from the discovery of Uranus.

title.zh: 伏打电堆与持续电流
title.en: The voltaic pile and sustained electric current

rationale.zh: 提供持续电流的可用实验来源，开启新的电化学与电磁研究。
rationale.en: Provided a sustained-current source for new electrochemical and electromagnetic experiments.

sources.title: Volta — Electricity excited by contact of conducting substances (1800)
University of Virginia — Electricity and Magnetism History

dateNote.zh: 取1800年3月致Banks信及同年公开报告，不按电池单元数重复计数。
dateNote.en: Dates the March 1800 Banks letter and public report, not individual battery cells.

title.zh: 杠杆与重心的数学静力学
title.en: Mathematical statics of levers and centres of gravity

rationale.zh: 将平衡问题转化为严格的几何论证。
rationale.en: Turned equilibrium problems into geometrical demonstrations.

dateNote.zh: 《论平面图形的平衡》的成书年份不详。
dateNote.en: The year of composition of On the Equilibrium of Planes is uncertain.

title.zh: 阿里斯塔克斯的日心构想
title.en: Aristarchus’s heliocentric proposal

rationale.zh: 提出地球运动的早期宇宙模型；现存依据主要为后人记述。
rationale.en: An early moving-Earth cosmology known mainly through later testimony.

dateNote.zh: 没有可核验的单一发表年份。 历史思想记录，不作为已成立物理原理计入突破指数。
dateNote.en: No securely attested publication year. Historical proposal; excluded from the index of established physical advances.

title.zh: 比鲁尼的地球半径测量方法
title.en: Al-Biruni’s method of measuring Earth’s radius

rationale.zh: 将山高与俯角测量结合到地球尺度的几何估计。
rationale.en: Combined height and dip-angle measurements in a geometrical Earth estimate.

dateNote.zh: 具体测量年未可靠确定，未采用常见但不充分支持的单年。
dateNote.en: The measurement year is not securely established in the consulted source.

title.zh: 布里丹的冲力说
title.en: Buridan’s impetus account

rationale.zh: 推进对持续运动及阻力的中世纪讨论，不等同牛顿惯性。
rationale.en: Advanced medieval accounts of persistence and resistance, distinct from Newtonian inertia.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — John Buridan

dateNote.zh: 论述见多次讲授及修订的作品，未强行指定单年。 历史思想记录，不作为已成立物理原理计入突破指数。
dateNote.en: The account occurs in repeatedly taught and revised works. Historical proposal; excluded from the index of established physical advances.

title.zh: 法里西的彩虹光学分析
title.en: Al-Farisi’s optical analysis of the rainbow

rationale.zh: 用实验模型和光路分析推进彩虹解释。
rationale.en: Advanced rainbow explanations with experimental models and ray paths.

dateNote.zh: 光学修订著作的单一年份缺乏足够核验。
dateNote.en: The optical revision has not been securely assigned a single year.

title.zh: 希罗的气动与蒸汽装置
title.en: Hero’s pneumatic and steam devices

rationale.zh: 记录压力驱动装置与反作用旋转装置。
rationale.en: Recorded pressure-driven mechanisms and a reaction-driven rotating device.

dateNote.zh: 《气动学》具体成书年份不详。
dateNote.en: The exact composition year of Pneumatica is uncertain.

title.zh: 发现岁差
title.en: Recognition of the precession of the equinoxes

rationale.zh: 通过跨时代观测比较识别天球坐标的长期变化。
rationale.en: Recognized secular changes through comparisons of observations across epochs.

dateNote.zh: 发现过程缺少可靠单年日期。
dateNote.en: The discovery process lacks a securely established single year.

title.zh: 后期墨家关于光影与成像的讨论
title.en: Later Mohist analysis of light and images

rationale.zh: 中国早期光学的系统论述；不是现代意义上的完整光学理论。
rationale.en: A systematic early Chinese treatment of optics, not a modern optical theory.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Mohist Canons

dateNote.zh: 约战国晚期；匿名后期墨家作品，不直接归为墨子亲作。
dateNote.en: Late Warring States compilation by later Mohists; not securely authored by Mozi.

title.zh: 用几何图示表示变化的运动量
title.en: Geometrical diagrams of varying motion

rationale.zh: 以几何面积和图形分析均匀变化的量。
rationale.en: Used geometrical areas and figures to analyze uniformly varying quantities.

dateNote.zh: 相关手稿的成书年代不确定。
dateNote.en: The relevant manuscripts are not securely dated.

title.zh: 以水球实验解释主虹与副虹
title.en: A water-sphere explanation of primary and secondary rainbows

rationale.zh: 把单个水滴中的折射和内反射与虹的形成联系起来。
rationale.en: Linked refraction and internal reflection in drops with rainbow formation.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Dietrich of Freiberg

dateNote.zh: 没有把作者活动年份直接当成著作完成年。
dateNote.en: Biographical activity dates are not substituted for the work’s date.
